title: Aigon language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Papua New Guinea
extract: Aigon (Aighon) is an Austronesian language spoken by about 2000 individuals between the Avio and Amgen rivers in West New Britain Province, Papua New Guinea on the island of New Britain.
